text:
incident-bot: P1 alert — zephyrus-13b model-family sudden TPM spike (x3) + elevated 5xx rate and p95 latency > 2s. Auto-throttle did not engage, paging eng-oncall.

oncall_alex: I'm on it. Pulling quota + telemetry, tagging SRE and runtime. @sre_maya @eng_runtime_tim please take look at per-model dashboard and top tenants.

sre_maya: Observed one tenant (gamepad-inc) responsible for ~65% of the extra traffic. Their average seq_len is ~1.8k causing KV pressure and backend timeouts. Error waterfall shows model infra 502s. Propose: apply conservative global TPM reduction for zephyrus-13b and add a per-tenant cap for gamepad-inc to protect others.

eng_runtime_tim: Agreed. Prefer two-step: 1) soft global throttle (graceful backpressure), 2) tenant-specific hard cap if spike persists. Also disable funcall for zephyrus-13b to reduce fanout (will drop external tool calls).

oncall_alex: Actions I will execute now: 1) softcap global TPM -> 450, 2) add tenant cap gamepad-inc -> 150, 3) disable funcall for zephyrus-13b.

oncall_alex: Running cli commands:
```
# softcap global
./opscli set-rate --model zephyrus-13b --soft-tpm 450 --reason "auto-mitigation pulse surge"
# tenant cap
./opscli set-tenant-cap --tenant gamepad-inc --model zephyrus-13b --tpm 150
# disable funcall for model family
./opscli feature-toggle --model zephyrus-13b --feature funcall --state off
```

infra_ops_li: Heads up — applying tenant cap will return 429s for that tenant. CS notified?

customer_success_roz: Notified gamepad-inc primary contact: Sofia. They confirmed a runaway test job earlier and asked us to throttle; they're pausing downstream ingestion. Expect them to be OK with temporary cap.

oncall_alex: Softcap + tenant cap + funcall disable applied. Monitoring metrics now.

sre_maya: Metrics update in 5m: aggregate TPM for zephyrus-13b dropped from ~1600 -> ~420. 5xx rate back to baseline (within margin). Latency p95 reduced to ~850ms. No other tenants impacted per APM.

eng_runtime_tim: I'll keep funcall disabled for 30m and watch KV cache churn. If stable, we can gradually raise softcap. Plan to re-enable funcall only if KV pressure remains low.

oncall_alex: Notifying stakeholders, leaving this thread for handoff to SRE monitoring shift in 20m. If anyone sees regression, ping @oncall_alex and escalate. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident auto-update — mitigation applied by oncall_alex. Severity P1 -> monitoring.

oncall_alex: Closing immediate mitigation. Follow-up: run postmortem to investigate why auto-throttle didn't trigger for this pattern and add tenant burst detection. Assigning to @sre_maya and @eng_runtime_tim.
